items.summary: Recommendation: reject all new queue and production work this cycle. No defensible production candidate remains because attribution is incomplete, telemetry is low-volume, no outcomes are proven, and prior implementation attempts failed. Retain the existing Great American Lakes measurement gate, keep SearchWoot private, and await the recorded measurement thresholds plus affiliate attribution reconciliation. Will you approve waiting for those existing evidence gates before authorizing further implementation?
